private lemma floor_count (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (f : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ f) (h1 : f < 1) :
    f - 1 / M ≤ (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∧
    (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ f := by
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  set m := ⌊(M : ℝ) * f⌋₊ with hm
  have hmf : (m : ℝ) ≤ M * f := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hfm : M * f < m + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hmM : m ≤ M := by
    have : (m : ℝ) < M := by nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this.le
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, ((j : ℝ) / M ≤ f ↔ j ≤ m) := by
    intro j
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hMr, hm, Nat.le_floor_iff (by positivity), mul_comm]
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = m := by
    simp_rw [key]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have : (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => j ≤ m) = Finset.Icc 1 m := by
      ext j; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
    rw [this, Nat.card_Icc]; simp
  rw [hsum]
  constructor
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, le_div_iff₀ hMr, sub_mul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hMr.ne']; nlinarith
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hMr]; nlinarith


private lemma gauss_Icc (M : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (j : ℝ) = (M : ℝ) * (M + 1) / 2 := by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
    push_cast; ring

theorem erdos_1094__h3__h3__h2 : ∀ (C : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
  (0 : ℝ) < ε →
    ∃ (K₄ : ℕ),
      ∀ (n k : ℕ),
        K₄ < k →
          k * k ≤ C * (n * Nat.log (2 : ℕ) k) →
            n < k * k →
              |∑ p ∈ Finset.range k with Nat.Prime p ∧ k < (2 : ℕ) * p ∧ (20 : ℕ) * p < (11 : ℕ) * k,
                    (Int.fract ((↑n : ℝ) / (↑p : ℝ)) - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.log (↑p : ℝ)| ≤
                ε * (↑k : ℝ) := by
  have h_theta : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range k).filter
      (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ k < 2 * p ∧ 20 * p < 11 * k), Real.log p ≤ 2 * k := by
    intro k
    have hsub : (Finset.range k).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ k < 2 * p ∧ 20 * p < 11 * k) ⊆
        (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊(k : ℝ)⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ioc, Nat.floor_natCast] at hp ⊢
      exact ⟨⟨hp.2.1.pos, hp.1.le⟩, hp.2.1⟩
    have hlog4 : Real.log 4 ≤ 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
      push_cast
      linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
    calc _ ≤ Chebyshev.theta k := by
          rw [Chebyshev.theta]
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun p _ _ => Real.log_natCast_nonneg p)
      _ ≤ Real.log 4 * k := Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2 * k := by gcongr
  have h_l51 : ∀ (C : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∃ K₅ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, K₅ < k →
      k * k ≤ C * (n * Nat.log 2 k) → n < k * k → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1 →
      |∑ p ∈ (Finset.range k).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ k < 2 * p ∧ 20 * p < 11 * k),
          (if Int.fract ((n : ℝ) / p) < σ then Real.log p else 0) -
        σ * ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range k).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ k < 2 * p ∧ 20 * p < 11 * k),
          Real.log p| ≤ δ * k := by
    sorry
  intro C ε hε
  obtain ⟨K₅, hL5⟩ := h_l51 C (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨K₅, fun n k hk hlow hup => ?_⟩
  set S := (Finset.range k).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ k < 2 * p ∧ 20 * p < 11 * k) with hS
  set L := ∑ p ∈ S, Real.log p with hLdef
  have hlog0 : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 ≤ Real.log p := fun p => Real.log_natCast_nonneg p
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => hlog0 p)
  have hL2 : L ≤ 2 * k := h_theta k
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := by positivity
  set M : ℕ := ⌈4 / ε⌉₊ + 1 with hMdef
  have hM : 0 < M := by omega
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hM4 : 4 / ε ≤ M := by
    have := Nat.le_ceil (4 / ε)
    have h2 : ((⌈4 / ε⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_succ _)
    linarith
  have hinvM : 1 / (M : ℝ) ≤ ε / 4 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hMr]
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hε).1 hM4
    nlinarith
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => Int.fract ((n : ℝ) / p) with hf
  set A : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
    (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) with hAdef
  have hA : ∀ p, f p - 1 / M ≤ A p ∧ A p ≤ f p := fun p =>
    floor_count M hM (f p) (Int.fract_nonneg _) (Int.fract_lt_one _)
  -- the swap of the two sums
  have hswap : ∑ p ∈ S, A p * Real.log p = (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
      ∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    rw [hAdef]; simp only
    rw [mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  -- each inner sum is L minus the count below σ = j/M
  have hinner : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
      |∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) - (L - ((j : ℝ) / M) * L)| ≤
        ε / 4 * k := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    have hσ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) / M := by positivity
    have hσ1 : (j : ℝ) / M ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hMr]; exact_mod_cast hj.2
    have h := hL5 n k hk hlow hup ((j : ℝ) / M) hσ0 hσ1
    have hsplit : ∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) =
        L - ∑ p ∈ S, (if f p < (j : ℝ) / M then Real.log p else 0) := by
      rw [hLdef, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      by_cases hc : (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p
      · rw [if_pos hc, if_neg (not_lt.2 hc)]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hc, if_pos (not_le.1 hc)]; ring
    rw [hsplit]
    have : L - ∑ p ∈ S, (if f p < (j : ℝ) / M then Real.log p else 0) - (L - (j : ℝ) / M * L) =
        -(∑ p ∈ S, (if f p < (j : ℝ) / M then Real.log p else 0) - (j : ℝ) / M * L) := by ring
    rw [this, abs_neg]
    exact h
  -- sum over j
  have hgsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (L - ((j : ℝ) / M) * L) = L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 := by
    have : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (L - ((j : ℝ) / M) * L) =
        (M : ℝ) * L - (L / M) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (j : ℝ) := by
      rw [show ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (L - ((j : ℝ) / M) * L) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (L - L / M * (j : ℝ)) from
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Icc]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [this, gauss_Icc]; field_simp; ring
  have hE : |∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) -
      L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2| ≤ M * (ε / 4 * k) := by
    rw [← hgsum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, |∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) -
          (L - ((j : ℝ) / M) * L)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ε / 4 * k := Finset.sum_le_sum hinner
      _ = M * (ε / 4 * k) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Icc]; simp
  -- bracket Σ f log p between Σ A log p and Σ A log p + L/M
  have hlo : ∑ p ∈ S, A p * Real.log p ≤ ∑ p ∈ S, f p * Real.log p :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA p).2 (hlog0 p))
  have hhi : ∑ p ∈ S, f p * Real.log p ≤ ∑ p ∈ S, A p * Real.log p + L / M := by
    rw [hLdef, Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro p _
    have := (hA p).1
    have hl := hlog0 p
    have : f p * Real.log p ≤ (A p + 1 / M) * Real.log p :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hl
    linarith [show (A p + 1 / M) * Real.log p = A p * Real.log p + Real.log p / M by ring]
  have htarget : ∑ p ∈ S, (Int.fract ((n : ℝ) / p) - 1 / 2) * Real.log p =
      ∑ p ∈ S, f p * Real.log p - L / 2 := by
    rw [hLdef, Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p _; simp only [hf]; ring
  rw [htarget]
  have hAval : ∑ p ∈ S, A p * Real.log p =
      (1 / (M : ℝ)) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0)) :=
    hswap
  set T := ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∑ p ∈ S, (if (j : ℝ) / M ≤ f p then Real.log p else 0) with hT
  have hE' := abs_le.1 hE
  have hLM : L / M ≤ 2 * k * (ε / 4) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
    exact mul_le_mul hL2 hinvM (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hTM1 : (1 / (M : ℝ)) * T ≤ L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 / M + ε / 4 * k := by
    rw [one_div_mul_eq_div, div_le_iff₀ hMr]
    have : (L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 / M + ε / 4 * k) * M = L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 + M * (ε / 4 * k) := by
      field_simp
    rw [this]; linarith [hE'.2]
  have hTM2 : L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 / M - ε / 4 * k ≤ (1 / (M : ℝ)) * T := by
    rw [one_div_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hMr]
    have : (L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 / M - ε / 4 * k) * M = L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 - M * (ε / 4 * k) := by
      field_simp
    rw [this]; linarith [hE'.1]
  have hmid : L * ((M : ℝ) - 1) / 2 / M = L / 2 - L / M / 2 := by field_simp
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith [hLM, hlo, hhi, hTM1, hTM2, hmid, hAval, div_nonneg hL0 hMr.le]
